methodology: Direct WebFetch/curl to vendor doc sites (aftership.com, api.17track.net, developer.laposte.fr, developer.dhl.com, developer.ups.com, docs.ship24.com, trackingmore.com, parcelsapp.com, parcelmonitor.com, chronopost.fr) was BLOCKED by the session egress proxy (HTTP 403 CONNECT / DNS failure). Sources used instead: (1) official vendor SDKs/specs cloned from public GitHub (AfterShip/tracking-sdk-nodejs @2026-07-13, API 2026-07; UPS-API/api-documentation Tracking.yaml @2026-10-07; ship24/ship24-node spec/ship24-tracking-api.yaml @2026-10-06; TrackingMore-API/trackingmore-sdk-nodejs @2024-02-04), (2) WebSearch snippets of official doc pages (quoted, not fully read), (3) community code (marked). The WebSearch budget ran out before the tracking-number format research; patterns therefore come from the community dataset jkeen/tracking_number_data plus earlier snippets. Anything not confirmed by an official source is marked 'unconfirmed'.

providers.name: 17TRACK Tracking API v2.4
providers.docs: https://api.17track.net/en/doc (fetch blocked; known via search snippets)
providers.auth: HTTP header '17token: <API key>' (confirmed by official doc snippet); key from 17TRACK API console

endpoints.fetch: POST https://api.17track.net/track/v2.4/gettrackinfo (confirmed via official doc snippet); v2.2 also had POST /track/v2.2/getRealTimeTrackInfo
endpoints.carrierDetection: Automatic on register when 'carrier' omitted (official v2.2 doc: if no carrier and several match, processed for each matched carrier). No standalone detect endpoint confirmed.
endpoints.other: stoptrack / retrack / deletetrack / changecarrier / getquota / gettracklist: unconfirmed under v2.4 (exist in older versions per memory, not verified)

providers.requestBody: JSON array of objects, max 40 per request: [{"number":"RR123456789CN","carrier":3011}] ; 'carrier' (integer key) optional for register; gettrackinfo example uses number + carrier (e.g. 100003, 21051)
providers.responseEnvelope: { "code": 0, "data": { "accepted": [ {"origin":1, "number":"RR123456789CN", "carrier":3011} ], "rejected": [ {"number":"1234", "error":{"code":-18010012, ...}} ] } } (field names accepted/rejected/origin/number/carrier and code -18010012 seen in official snippets; exact 'error' sub-object shape unconfirmed)

status.field: track_info.latest_status.status and track_info.latest_status.sub_status (sub_status path quoted by official help center; 'track_info' quoted by v2.2 docs; full path unconfirmed)
status.valuesSource: https://help.17track.net/hc/en-us/articles/37471096573337-Understanding-Tracking-Status-Main-Status-Substatus (9 main statuses, 30 sub-statuses; e.g. NotFound_Other, NotFound_InvalidCode, InTransit_PickedUp, InTransit_Departure, InTransit_CustomsProcessing)
status.expiredRule: Expired = >75 days since InfoReceived without delivery (help center)

providers.events: Per-event fields time_iso, description, location appear on 17track.net/en/api example; container path (e.g. track_info.tracking.providers[].events[]) and fields time_utc/stage/sub_status: unconfirmed

webhook.events: TRACKING_UPDATED (immediate on status change), also TRACKING_STOPPED unconfirmed
webhook.signature: Header 'sign' = hex(SHA256(rawBody + '/' + apiKey)) per v2 doc snippet and help-center Python example (https://help.17track.net/hc/en-us/articles/37573146087321-Webhook-Development-Example-Code). v1 put sign in body - use v2.x rule and verify against a test push.

providers.freeTier: Per official API doc notice: effective 2026-01-07 00:00 UTC the monthly 100 free numbers ended; accounts registered after that date get a ONE-TIME 200 free tracking numbers. (Older help-center 'Plan Details' still says 100/month - outdated.) 1 successful registration = 1 quota; continued tracking of a registered number costs no extra quota (help center).
providers.paidPricing: Prepaid annual quota packs, valid 12 months (help center). Price figures only from third parties: ~$119 / 5,000 numbers / year up to $9,299 / 500,000 (Ship24 comparison - competitor) - unconfirmed
providers.signup: 17TRACK account + API console key; email signup; no contract
providers.rateLimits: 3 requests/second, max 40 numbers per request, HTTP 429 above (official help center); optional daily cap configurable
providers.privacy: Chinese-headquartered company (Shenzhen) - check GDPR/DPA terms before sending customer emails/names; only send tracking numbers. unconfirmed
providers.fitForSmallFrenchSeller: Best value: auto-detection, widest FR coverage incl. Colis Prive/Relais Colis/DPD FR, cheap prepaid annual packs, signed webhooks. Weakness: response schema could not be verified from here; free quota now one-time only.

providers.name: AfterShip Tracking API (version 2026-07; previous 2025-07, 2025-04, 2025-01, 2024-xx)
providers.docs: https://www.aftership.com/docs/tracking/2026-07/quickstart/api-quick-start (fetch blocked) ; official SDK https://github.com/AfterShip/tracking-sdk-nodejs (read, API Version 2026-07, SDK 17.0.0)
providers.auth: Header 'as-api-key: <key>' (confirmed in SDK src/lib/request.ts and quickstart snippet). Optional signed modes: 'as-signature-hmac-sha256' (AES) or 'as-signature-rsa-sha256' (RSA).

endpoints.carrierDetection: POST https://api.aftership.com/tracking/2026-07/couriers/detect ; also auto-detect when slug omitted on create (restricted to couriers enabled in admin -> error 4012 BAD_COURIER otherwise)

providers.requestBody: CreateTrackingRequest: tracking_number (required), slug?, slug_group?, title?, order_id?, order_number?, destination_postal_code?, destination_country_region?, language?, customers?[], note? ... DetectCourierRequest: tracking_number (required), slug?[], slug_group?, destination_postal_code?, tracking_ship_date?, origin_country_region?, destination_country_region?
providers.events: data.checkpoints[]: checkpoint_time (carrier local time), created_at, location, city, state, postal_code, country_region (ISO3), country_region_name, message, tag, subtag, subtag_message, raw_tag, slug, hash (dedupe) - SDK src/model/Checkpoint.ts
providers.estimatedDelivery: data.courier_estimated_delivery_date{estimated_delivery_date,estimated_delivery_date_min,estimated_delivery_date_max}; data.latest_estimated_delivery{type: specific|range, source: 'Carrier EDD'|'AfterShip EDD'|'Custom EDD'|'Order EDD', datetime, datetime_min, datetime_max, revise_reason}; data.aftership_estimated_delivery_date; data.first_estimated_delivery

webhook.signature: Header 'aftership-hmac-sha256' = base64(HMAC-SHA256(rawBody, webhookSecret)); secret in admin Settings > Webhooks/Notifications (https://www.aftership.com/docs/tracking/2026-07/webhook/webhook-signature). No timestamp header (third-party note, unconfirmed)

providers.freeTier: A Free plan (~50 shipments/month) exists per third parties, but API + webhooks require Premium for new accounts (unconfirmed from official page; pricing page fetch blocked)
providers.paidPricing: Official pricing page snippet (marked old): Essentials from $29/mo, Premium from $59/mo (annual) incl. API, 6,000 shipments/year; Shopify listing $70/mo Premium. unconfirmed for 2026.
providers.signup: AfterShip account (admin.aftership.com) + API key (organization.automizely.com/api-keys); courier must be enabled in courier settings for auto-detect
providers.rateLimits: 10 requests/second default (SDK error table); headers X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset
providers.fitForSmallFrenchSeller: Cleanest, best-documented API (fully confirmed from official SDK) but API access is paywalled (~$59-70/mo) - overkill for a small reseller.

patterns.carrier: UPU S10 (international postal: La Poste Lettre/Colissimo International, Chronopost Intl, Chinese posts...)
patterns.checksum: S10 mod 11, weights [8,6,4,2,3,5,9,7] on 8 serial digits; check = 11 - (sum % 11), 10->0, 11->5
patterns.fr: suffix FR = La Poste / Colissimo / Chronopost (S10 suffix = issuing country); prefix letters (e.g. C*, L*, R*, E*) indicate service class
patterns.ambiguity: Any S10 number from any country; suffix tells origin post, not last-mile carrier

patterns.source: community / unconfirmed - example seen in https://github.com/debuss/lapostesuivi tests/Mock/200.json; 2L00754800000 in developpez.net forum
patterns.ambiguity: 13-char alnum overlaps with S10 (S10 has 2 letters at end); prefixes not officially documented here
Indistinguishable from La Poste S10 by regex alone - route both to La Poste Suivi v2 which covers Chronopost
HIGH - 10 digits also matches Colis Prive? / Mondial Relay? / many others; always confirm via aggregator detection

patterns.regex: ^\d{14}$ (DPD France 14 digits, per TrackingMore) ; international parcel label: ^\d{14}[0-9A-Z]$ with mod 37/36 check char
patterns.ambiguity: HIGH - 14 digits also matches DHL eCommerce (14) and FedEx Ground fragments

patterns.source: community pattern / unconfirmed (no official spec read; MR WS doc V-5.12 defines Expedition as 8 digits - unconfirmed)
patterns.ambiguity: HIGH - pure digits; tracing via MR web service also needs Enseigne + key

recommendation: Integrate 17TRACK API v2.4 first: auto carrier detection on /register (no carrier needed), 3,400+ carriers including the full French set (La Poste/Colissimo, Chronopost, Mondial Relay, Colis Prive, Relais Colis, DPD FR, GLS, UPS, DHL), signed webhooks (header 'sign' = sha256(body + '/' + key)), 3 req/s & 40 numbers/request, one quota per registered number, and the cheapest paid path (prepaid annual packs, ~USD 119 / 5,000 numbers per third-party data). Caveats: since 2026-01-07 the free tier is a one-time 200 numbers (not monthly), and its response field paths (track_info.*) could not be verified here - verify against https://api.17track.net/en/doc before coding. Add La Poste Suivi v2 (Okapi, X-Okapi-Key, GET https://api.laposte.fr/suivi/v2/idships/{id}) as a free official route for La Poste/Colissimo/Chronopost numbers (polling, no webhooks) - this also saves 17TRACK quota since most French C2C/B2C parcels go via Colissimo. Fallback aggregator if 17TRACK is unsuitable: Ship24 (fully verified OpenAPI, Bearer auth, free 10/month, Pro $39/month/1,000). AfterShip is the best-documented but its API needs a paid Premium plan (~$59-70/month): not recommended for a small reseller.
